title: Tribal Knowledge Reinforcement + Proactive Intelligence
description: Enhance tribal knowledge with reinforcement learning from outcomes, confidence calibration based on usage, and proactive suggestion capabilities for AI reasoning. Prepares foundation for AI-INTEG-MS4 (Proactive Learning Integration).

units.title: Outcome Tracking & Reinforcement Learning
units.description: Track which tips lead to successful vs failed outcomes. Implement feedback loop to adjust tip relevance and surface successful tips more often.

units.title: Confidence Calibration Engine
units.description: Dynamically adjust tip confidence based on usage outcomes. Tips that consistently work get boosted; tips that fail get deweighted.

units.title: Proactive Tribal Suggestions
units.description: Generate proactive tribal suggestions before user asks, based on detected context patterns. Integrate with ProactiveIntelligenceEngine.

summary.ai_integration: Full reinforcement learning loop for tribal knowledge with Bayesian confidence calibration and proactive suggestion generation for PUOA integration
